tools.name: confirm_connection
tools.description: Confirm the connection ID from the Lemongraph setup prompt after OAuth sign-in. Uses your authenticated user and application identity. This works even when the user has no plan or time zone.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Return today's ordered plan and suggestions using the user's saved timezone. This is not every task. Requires a timezone in Lemongraph Settings. Use returned IDs for actions. When the user selects a task to work on, call get_task_context with its eight-character data.key, not the card's top-level ke

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Get the stored execution brief for a task the user selected. Copy its eight-character data.key exactly from get_today or a dependency in a previous brief. Returns the task description and comments, progress notes agents logged on it, oldest first, commitments, the evidence behind the task context, p

tools.name: start_task
tools.description: Start working on the selected task using its exact eight-character data.key. The server identifies your application. If another agent is already working on it, respect the error and do not proceed. Call stop_task if you stop without finishing.

tools.name: stop_task
tools.description: Stop working on a task you started, using its exact eight-character key. Releases your claim without completing the task. Another application cannot release your active claim. Log a hand-off note with log_task_progress first.

tools.name: log_task_progress
tools.description: Report progress on a task you started, using its exact eight-character key. The user reads it in the task timeline. Write plain text: what you did, decisions you made and why, what is next, and any blocker. In progress reports and hand-off notes, also flag missing, outdated or conflicting informatio

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a native Lemongraph task when requested. Accepts a title and optional Markdown content, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), priority, one tag, and participant emails. A tag is 1–20 characters and can include emoji and spaces; omit it for Inbox. A due date is a calendar day, not a timed reminder. Do not inv

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an open native Lemongraph task using its exact eight-character data.key. Accepts optional title, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD or null), priority, tag, and edits. Set tag to a name to reuse or create it, or null to move the task to Inbox. A tag is 1–20 characters and can include emoji and spaces. Task

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Complete a native todo (type: todo, id), hide a commitment (type: commitment, commitment), or mark a note read (type: note, jobId and milestoneId). Use identifiers returned by get_today, not a context lookup key. External services are unchanged.

tools.name: approve_card
tools.description: Approve or hire a suggestion once using its id from get_today. This may start external actions including email. Explaining a suggestion does not authorize approval. An explicit approval request is sufficient when the effect is clear. Success means approval, not finished downstream work.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_task_context, update_task · Public sink: create_task, approve_card · Destructive: update_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_task_context, update_task · Public sink: create_task, approve_card · Destructive: update_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_task" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
